description: Removes a sitemap from the property. Two-step: the first call returns a confirmation token, the second performs the removal.

confirm_token.description: The token from this tool's previous refusal. Call without it first to see what would happen and receive the token; it cannot be guessed or reused.

feedpath.description: The full URL of the sitemap to remove

site_url.description: The Search Console property: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or "https://example.com/" for a URL-prefix property (the trailing slash is required)

name: delete_sitemap
title: Remove a sitemap
